notes: Ready for review: #614 slice 1 in 2debe6d. Reason(rule, origin, result, code, location, detail); kernel Origin(name), non-blank. Origin choice (for ADR-0083): a closure fault's origin is the check that found it and its reason's rule name is the origin's name (CompositionRules.ORIGIN=closure, PRESETS_ORIGIN=closure.presets, ClosureFault.ORIGIN=closure for the other closure checks and lifted refusals, so no rule name changes); every non-closure reason's origin is its rule name (Constraint description, Reason.passed/failed, Findings code value). Note: this differs from architectural-patterns-applied.md's proposed Origin (an element id), as the WP prescribed a check name. Guard OneClosureFaultTypeTest and ReasonTest red-first. No expected value changed in pins; out-of-map edits are type/factory-only call sites.
